name: Do I need a licensed plumber or a general contractor to install bathroom fixtures?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a licensed plumber or a general contractor to install bathroom fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: A licensed plumbing trade specialist is recommended whenever installation involves shower control valves, relocating waste lines, or adjusting main supply pipes behind finished walls. Simple surface swaps, such as replacing a vanity faucet or a standard toilet on a sound flange, are often completed by skilled finish contractors or handyman services. When comprehensive bathroom remodels involve both interior finishes and concealed pipe adjustments, an owner-operated general contractor manages the carpentry, tile, and drywall while coordinating qualified plumbing trades for code-compliant valve work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor handles finish carpentry, tile, and fixture swaps while coordinating licensed plumbing trades for in-wall valves and relocated pipe lines.
